about_the_game:
Build. Train. Battle. Survive the martial world.

Turn-based tactical battle with real-time base management and character growth, all serving your grand strategy. Lead your Wuxia sect, build strongholds, craft weapons, train disciples, expand territory, make allies, and engage in deep tactical combat to dominate the realms of martial arts. No RNG*

Train Disciples, Shape Legends

Cultivate your disciples to become martial arts legends, or train them in the practical skills needed to keep your sect thriving.

  • Forge and Cultivate: Master six categories of martial arts: bare-hand, bladed weapons, polearms, hidden weapons, lightfoot, and mystic arts. Each includes dozens of unique techniques, and a true genius can master them all.

  • Recruit and Nurture: Scout and recruit from a vast cast of unique disciples. A recruit's talents are influenced by their origin, and you must train each according to their unique nature.

  • Manage Your Sect: Manage your sect’s economy by collecting tuition from disciples and paying wages to hired workers. A single full-time martial artist requires a huge amount of support, so building a prosperous sect is key to your success.

Manage Your Sect in Real-Time

Construct and design your sect in real-time to optimize efficiency, defense, and strategic growth.

  • Custom Base Building: Design your base to optimize production and training, transforming it into a business hub or a martial arts sanctuary.

  • Strategic Layouts: Arrange your buildings to gain a defensive advantage and minimize losses during combat.

  • A Living Economy: Trade with merchants and manage your staff to generate wealth, hire managers for key positions, and build a thriving sect.

  • Diverse Buildings: Construct, upgrade, and dismantle a wide variety of buildings, from training halls and crafting workshops to libraries for developing new martial arts.

Turn-based Tactical Combat Without Chance

Engage in tactical turn-based combat where strategic positioning and forward planning determine the outcome.

  • Pure Strategy: Success hinges on careful planning—there is no RNG to save or doom you.

  • Know Before You Act: See the outcome of your attack before you commit to it, allowing you to plan every move with precision.

  • Perma-Death: Fail to save a disciple during battle, and they are gone forever.

  • Unique Sects: Every martial arts sect focuses on a different style, resulting in drastically varied combat strategies and playstyles.

  • Dynamic Battlefields: Use the varied terrain and destructible environments of 3D battlefields to your advantage.

  • Customize Your Arsenal: Loot, salvage, and customize a vast array of weapons and equipment to find the perfect combination for each battle.

To Conquer or Endure

Choose your own path to glory through five distinct win conditions and shape your sect’s destiny through its interactions with the world.

  • Five Paths to Victory:

    • Be the last sect standing.

    • Accumulate immense wealth.

    • Cultivate a disciple to be the #1 Martial Artist.

    • Unite the world as the leader of a grand alliance.

    • Discover the world’s most advanced martial art technique.

  • A Living World: Your sect’s survival depends on your interactions with emperors, warlords, outlaws, and fellow martial artists.

  • Become Notorious or Illustrious: Rob, trade with, or protect passing caravans. Your sect can become renowned for its good deeds or infamous for its villainy, both of which will have a huge impact on the world.

  • The Path of a Recluse: Fame isn’t your only option. You can remain an unknown sect and survive by staying out of the world’s affairs.

⚔️ Every disciple. Every battle. Every choice. Your sect’s story is yours to write.

content_descriptors.notes:
The whole game is set in Ancient East Asia where all characters lives in a world full of (potentially superhuman) martial artists, basically eastern fantasy. 
These Kung-Fu masters fight against each other for various reasons through out the game. Learning martial art techniques and using them to fight constitutes majority of the gameplay. 
There are certain fictional martial art techniques that requires self-harm to learn/practice, some are even suicidal by design in exchange for huge damage, most likely to sacrifice oneself in order to save others. 
When a character's health reduced to 0, the character will become "dying" and might end up "dead" and leave the game world forever if not helped in time. 
There are no visual representation of blood, only a de-buff state "bleeding" and corresponding icon. 
Some characters might occasionally curse to reflect their (likely negative) personality.

short_description: A fusion of turn-based tactical combat, real-time base management, and grand strategy. Lead your sect, train disciples, forge alliances, and conquer the martial realms—where every strike’s outcome is known, including loot. No more misses at 95% hit rate: victory is forged by strategy, not luck.
